featured_reviews.name: richa shukla
featured_reviews.review_text:
A case of spontaneous tattoo!
I called to ask if I could walk-in in the next fifteen minutes, luckily they had space and I got to meet the beautiful soul that is Prerna. It’s always important to be tattooed by a like-for-like vibe and I’m so lucky to have found that! Initially I came to get an existing tattoo amended, Prerna advised to get an additional small tattoo to make it worth it monetarily, I obvs had one in mind I’ve meant to get for years so today was the day! It was quick, easy, fun, and barely felt a thing! I’ll definitely be back! Thank you Prerna!

Update - I was in Mumbai for a week four months later, so had to stop by and add to the collection! We went for some ambitious abdomen Tatts (ambitious because they were working amongst stretch marks and constant weight fluctuations). Prerna was reassuring, unlike other artists didn’t see it as a challenge, and the result was the sexiest, confident boosting, smooth lined tattoo I have now. Given the laxity of skin Prerna managed smooth clean lines, we worked together on the design and she really saw my vision. Not only this, but the tattoo is perfectly aligned amongst others in the area, as well as with the pre-existing scars on my body. To put it bluntly, every mark on my body now looks completely intentional, as though it’s one intricate image not a collection of tattoos over the years. To put it even more bluntly, the only downside is having to wear clothes, I only want to wear these tattoos now! As usual, we had so much fun, chats about life and love, singing to great music (I didn’t think it was possible to be so chill you could sing along to old songs while getting an abdo tattoo but obvs it’s Prerna and I barely felt pain).
Look I could go on and on, this girl is the best in Asia and I’d get a piece from her quick before she really booms internationally.

owner_posts.post_text:
Fine line jellyfish, drifting up the arm. 🪼

Karan's dotwork shading on these is what makes them feel like they are actually floating. The soft gradient on the bells, the trailing tentacles, the scattered dots like bubbles around them. 

This is the kind of delicate work that takes a steady, experienced hand.
Fine line is one of our most requested styles at Ace Tattooz Colaba, and Karan is one of the artists who does it best.

📞 8450999943

Some devotional tattoos are a single symbol. This one is a whole world.

The trishul, the damru, the rudraksha, the lotus, the temple at the base. Karan built each element into a flowing forearm composition where everything connects. 

The black and grey shading gives the trishul a real metallic weight.
This is the kind of Mahadev piece that takes planning before the needle even touches skin. 

If that is what you are looking for, come see us at Ace Tattooz Colaba.

📞 8450999943

Some people pray with their hands. Some people carry their devotion on their skin.

This custom Mahadev tattoo built from every sacred Shiva element - trishul, rudraksha, Om, shankh, damru and lotus - is the second kind of prayer. Permanent. 

Intentional. Built line by line at Ace Tattooz.

If you have been carrying a Shiva tattoo idea and have not found someone who understands the meaning behind every element, come talk to us at Ace Tattooz Colaba.
📞 8450999943

Matching wrist tattoos work when the execution is identical on both sides. 

These daisy wrist tattoos by Mahima Bhanushali are exactly that.

One flower, done twice, with no variation in petal shading, leaf placement or the tiny pink berry accents. If you are thinking about matching tattoos with someone, this is what the standard looks like.

📞 8450999943

Three different flowers, three different colours, one composition that holds together completely.

Mahima Bhanushali did this colour floral bouquet on the calf and every flower in it sits at a different depth.

The pink rose reads first, the blue rose second, the yellow sunflower anchors the bottom. That kind of layering does not happen by accident.

Browse the full floral gallery:

Red petals with sharp clean edges. 

The inside of the flower looks like someone painted a galaxy into it. 

Blue, yellow, green, purple, all bleeding into each other the way watercolour is supposed to.

Archana Nakhua Bhanushali has been doing this for 15 years and this watercolour lotus is one of the pieces clients reference most when they walk in.

Explore lotus designs:

Upper back tattoos are one of the most powerful placements you can choose. 

This ornamental lotus with mandala wings by Mahima Bhanushali is exactly why.

The lotus sits at the top of the spine in pink and blue. Everything else radiates outward from it in black and grey. Symmetrical, detailed, permanent.

Browse our lotus work:

Some people get a tattoo to remember someone they lost. Some get one to celebrate someone still very much here.

Either way, a pet portrait tattoo done well is one of the most personal pieces you can carry. 

Karan Bhanushali did this Golden Retriever portrait in fine line with a botanical frame. 

The face has the exact energy of a dog who is genuinely happy to see you. That is not easy to capture and it does not happen by accident.

Ace Tattooz Colaba, Pasta Lane.
📞 8450999943

A tattoo about your passion hits differently than any other kind.

This tennis tattoo by Karan Bhanushali is not a simple racket outline. 

It is a full composition built around movement, energy and what the sport actually feels like in your body when you are playing it. 

Abstract lines, ink splashes, a ball mid-flight, red thread running through the chaos.

Whatever your sport or passion is, we can build something around it that actually means something. 

Ace Tattooz Colaba, Pasta Lane.
📞 8450999943

Most mandala tattoos stop at the circle. This one does not.

Mahima built the Om in the centre, then the petal rings, then the trishul geometry cutting through the composition like an axis. 

The result is a tattoo that reads as spiritual and geometric at the same time without either element cancelling the other out.

Two sessions. One very patient client. One exceptionally detail-oriented artist.

If you have a mandala idea that is more specific than what you have seen elsewhere, come talk to us at Ace Tattooz Colaba.
📞 8450999943
